CASE STUDY · AI PRODUCT

AI-Powered Resume Optimizer

An AI-assisted career platform centered on resume quality, ATS compatibility, and job-description relevance.

Problem

Job seekers need clearer feedback on resume quality and stronger alignment with target job descriptions.

Solution

A dynamic platform combining resume analysis, ATS evaluation, matching, and AI-assisted career tools.

Implementation

FastAPI services with Supabase PostgreSQL, JWT authentication, OAuth integration, Cloudinary media handling, and AI model integrations.

Engineering focus

Designed as a full product experience rather than an isolated model demo, with authentication, persistence, media infrastructure, and a user-facing workflow.
CASE STUDY · FULL-STACK PLATFORM

WYWA NGO Platform

A full-stack digital home for the Waziristan Youth Welfare Association and its community work.

Problem

The organization needed a structured public presence for activities, leadership, news, and participation.

Solution

A dynamic site covering activities, organizational information, gallery, news, contact, and donations.

Implementation

Next.js frontend with Node.js and Express services, PostgreSQL, Prisma, an admin management system, and cloud deployment.

Engineering focus

Balanced public communication with manageable internal content operations across several organizational sections.
CASE STUDY · COMMERCE

Zaitoun Loralai

A full-stack e-commerce platform supporting an olive oil business from product management to customer ordering.

Problem

The business needed a digital product experience with a practical ordering path for its customers.

Solution

Product and customer functionality, admin controls, and WhatsApp-based ordering in one integrated platform.

Implementation

React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS on the frontend; FastAPI, database integration, and JWT authentication on the backend.

Engineering focus

Connected a modern storefront experience with secured management functionality and a familiar customer conversion channel.
